title: pilosella glaucescens subsp. branae
intro: Pilosella glaucescens subsp. branae, commonly known as a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family, is a rare and lesser-known plant species. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents present in Pilosella glaucescens subsp. branae include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. These actions make it a potential source for the development of novel therapeutic agents, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
